services.name: Sunset Cruise Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a private dolphin and wildlife cruise through the scenic waters of the Outer Banks. The Daytime Cruise with Old Man Charters is perfect for guests who want to slow down, take in the views, and experience dolphins, coastal wildlife, and local waterways at a relaxed, comfortable pace. Unlike typical dolphin tours that simply head out and return to the dock, our private cruises allow time to linger with dolphins, explore wildlife-rich areas, and enjoy optional activities like swimming, sand island exploration, or simply cruising and relaxing on the water.
